verdict.rationale: Lambda's filesystems ship an S3-compatible adapter for copying files to and from them with standard tools like rclone and s5cmd. Lambda charges no ingress or egress fees and requires no long-term commitments, so a user can pull their stored data out and leave. Coverage is limited to filesystem data, not a documented account-wide export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or data export covering instance disks, account metadata and usage records; explicit open-format guarantees; any offboarding or account-deletion procedure; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This adapter allows you to use S3-compatible tools like rclone and s5cmd to copy files to and from your filesystems and perform common file operations.
There is no minimum storage period, and you are not charged for ingress or egress.
